question: If tan θ + sin θ = A and tan θ - sin θ = B, then what is the value of A² - B²?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply the algebraic identity: **(x + y)² − (x − y)² = 4xy**

In this problem, let **x = tan θ** and **y = sin θ**.

Then, **A = x + y** and **B = x − y**.

**A² − B² = (x + y)² − (x − y)² = 4xy = 4 tan θ sin θ**.

**∴ The correct answer is 4 tan θ sin θ.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A = tan θ + sin θ

B = tan θ − sin θ

**Formula Used:**

Algebraic Identity: **a² − b² = (a + b)(a − b)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b9d0ab869869292929a06988d92af69ad320b686de63dd2b7fc62e8c0c87e3e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **A + B** = (tan θ + sin θ) + (tan θ − sin θ)

⇒ **A + B** = 2 tan θ

⇒ **A − B** = (tan θ + sin θ) − (tan θ − sin θ)

⇒ **A − B** = tan θ + sin θ − tan θ + sin θ = 2 sin θ

⇒ **A² − B²** = (2 tan θ) × (2 sin θ)

⇒ **A² − B²** = 4 tan θ sin θ

**∴ The correct answer is 4 tan θ sin θ.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Square of Sum and Difference

The expression **(x + y)² − (x − y)²** always simplifies to **4xy**, which is a common algebraic tool in trigonometry.

Square Root Relation

For the given A and B, **A × B = tan²θ − sin²θ = tan²θsin²θ**, thus **A² − B² = 4√(AB)**.

Trigonometric Identity

**tan θ = sin θ / cos θ**, which implies **tan²θ − sin²θ = sin²θ (1/cos²θ − 1) = sin²θ tan²θ**.</p
